critical_code_review_comments: routers/vendors.py vendor_stats() iterates every movement in-process to compute trips/avg; fine for current data volume but a Mongo aggregation pipeline with $group would scale better.

routers/issues.py list_issues sorts in Mongo by created_at desc then re-sorts in Python by (status!='open', created_at) ascending. The initial Mongo sort is wasted work; a single $sort with status priority would be cleaner.

routers/jobs.py enrich_job now also issues one issues.count_documents per job on the list endpoint (N+1 for issues as well as units+POs). Consider a single aggregation for the jobs list at larger scale.

models/issue.py Issue inherits from IssueCreate so unit_id is Optional[str]; good — but there is no FK integrity check on job deletion aside from the explicit cascade in delete_job (tested, works). If future endpoints bulk-delete units, remember to also update issue.unit_number.
ApprovalsTab/IssuesTab: no loading/empty-state spinner on initial fetch — minor UX nit (currently relies on parent page's loading state).
